After taking a reference, check whether the nulls node is unhashed in
both IPv4 and IPv6 established lookups. If it is unhashed or the tuple
no longer matches, drop the reference and restart the lookup.

Lookups racing with the TIME_WAIT hashdance, or with a request being
replaced by its child, now restart and find the new socket instead of
returning the old one.

Request sockets that were never inserted into ehash can have a nonzero
refcount, and a stale lookup can hold a transient reference. Therefore,
when SYN cookie, Fast Open, and request migration paths fail after
setting a nonzero refcount, release the references held by those paths
with reqsk_put() instead of freeing the request directly.

ai.summary_en: The day's top vulnerabilities reveal a high-risk environment characterized by widespread remote code execution, authentication bypasses, and privilege escalation flaws spanning desktop operating systems, network devices, and cloud infrastructure. Microsoft ecosystems face significant pressure due to critical memory corruption and protocol weaknesses in Windows components, Office suites, and SQL Server, alongside security gaps in developer tools and collaboration platforms. Network equipment from vendors such as Fortinet and Citrix suffers from multiple configuration and injection defects, while industrial control and IoT deployments are compromised by hardcoded backdoors and unauthenticated access vectors, demanding immediate remediation to prevent systemic breaches.
ai.summary_zh: 今日高危漏洞揭示了一个高风险环境，其特征是跨桌面操作系统、网络设备和云基础设施的广泛远程代码执行、身份验证绕过及权限提升缺陷。由于 Windows 组件、Office 套件和 SQL Server 中存在关键内存损坏与协议弱点，加之开发工具与协作平台的安全缺口，Microsoft 生态系统面临严峻考验。Fortinet 和 Citrix 等厂商的网络设备存在多项配置与注入缺陷，而工业控制与物联网部署则因硬编码后门及无认证访问向量遭到破坏，亟需立即采取修复措施以防系统性入侵。

items.reason_en: World-writable /tmp dependency in Open Object Rexx allows local privilege escalation and macro injection by any unprivileged user.
items.reason_zh: Open Object Rexx 中 /tmp 依赖项的全局可写属性允许任何非特权用户进行本地权限提升和宏注入。

items.reason_en: Bounds checking flaw in RXAPI enables arbitrary code execution via crafted messages targeting desktop scripting environments.
items.reason_zh: RXAPI 中的边界检查缺陷允许通过针对桌面脚本环境的构造消息实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unicode space padding in 7-Zip bypasses security warnings, facilitating deceptive file execution on end-user systems.
items.reason_zh: 7-Zip 中的 Unicode 空格填充可绕过安全警告，从而在终端用户系统中促成欺骗性文件执行。

items.reason_en: OS command injection via web link URLs in CherryTree executes shell commands when custom actions are enabled.
items.reason_zh: 当启用自定义操作时，CherryTree 中通过 Web 链接 URL 的 OS 命令注入将执行 Shell 命令。

items.reason_en: Malicious repositories can override security settings in the Coder VS Code extension, potentially executing arbitrary commands locally.
items.reason_zh: 恶意仓库可能覆盖 Coder VS Code 扩展中的安全设置，从而潜在地在本地执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Excel allows remote code execution via crafted documents, posing a severe threat to enterprise workstations.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许通过构造的文档实现远程代码执行，对企业工作站构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Microsoft Office OneNote enables attackers to compromise user systems through maliciously crafted files without additional user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office OneNote 中的远程代码执行漏洞使攻击者能够通过恶意构造的文件在无需额外用户交互的情况下入侵用户系统。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation in Creative Labs Audigy Rx driver allows low-privilege users to gain administrator rights via vulnerable kernel module loading.
items.reason_zh: Creative Labs Audigy Rx 驱动程序中的本地权限提升漏洞允许低权限用户通过加载存在漏洞的内核模块获取管理员权限。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Print Spooler allows unauthorized network attackers to execute code, maintaining a high-risk attack vector for widespread printer-based exploits.
items.reason_zh: Windows Print Spooler 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许未授权的网络攻击者执行代码，为广泛传播的基于打印机的漏洞利用保留了高风险攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in the Remote Desktop Client enables remote code execution, directly compromising secure administrative access workflows.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的双重释放漏洞可启用远程代码执行，直接破坏安全的管理访问工作流。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Excel allows remote code execution via malicious documents, serving as a common initial access vector for targeted phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许通过恶意文档实现远程代码执行，作为定向网络钓鱼活动的常见初始访问向量。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Visual Studio Code permits local code execution by bypassing input validation, threatening developer workstations and integrated CI/CD environments.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的命令注入漏洞通过绕过输入验证允许本地代码执行，威胁开发人员工作站及集成 CI/CD 环境。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Shell allows remote code execution, potentially enabling arbitrary code execution when users interact with crafted shell extensions or shortcuts.
items.reason_zh: Windows Shell 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许远程代码执行，当用户与构造的 Shell 扩展或快捷方式交互时，可能实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in the Windows Storage Spaces Controller enables network-based code execution by an unauthorized attacker, posing a severe risk to enterprise storage infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows Storage Spaces Controller 中的整数下溢漏洞允许未授权攻击者进行基于网络的代码执行，对企业存储基础设施构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the XPS Document Converter allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code over a network, directly impacting document processing workflows.
items.reason_zh: XPS Document Converter 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许远程攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，直接影响文档处理工作流。

items.reason_en: Untrusted search path vulnerability in the Remote Desktop Client facilitates network-based privilege escalation, compromising secure remote administration channels.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的不受信任的搜索路径漏洞可促进基于网络的权限提升，破坏安全的远程管理通道。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Microsoft Office Excel permits remote code execution via maliciously crafted spreadsheet files, targeting a widely deployed productivity suite.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel 中的堆溢出漏洞允许通过恶意构造的电子表格文件实现远程代码执行，针对的是广泛部署的生产力套件。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Outlook enables network code execution through email attachments, presenting a high-risk attack vector for corporate environments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Outlook 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许通过电子邮件附件实现网络代码执行，为企业环境呈现高风险攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Critical RCE in Windows Search allows network-based exploitation without authentication, posing severe system compromise risks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Search 中的关键远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞允许无需身份验证即可进行基于网络的漏洞利用，带来严重的系统被入侵风险。

items.reason_en: High-severity code injection in VS Code enables remote attackers to execute arbitrary code during development workflows.
items.reason_zh: VS Code 中的高危代码注入漏洞使远程攻击者能够在开发工作流期间执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Office Word poses a significant risk for malicious document-driven attacks targeting end-users.
items.reason_zh: Office Word 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出对针对终端用户的恶意文档驱动攻击构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: PowerShell code injection vulnerability could allow unauthorized local code execution, undermining system integrity.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell 代码注入漏洞可能导致未授权的本地代码执行，从而破坏系统完整性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Outlook enables remote code execution via malicious emails, directly targeting end-user workstations with high phishing exploitability.
items.reason_zh: Outlook 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许通过恶意邮件实现远程代码执行，直接针对具有高网络钓鱼可利用性的终端用户工作站。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Word allows remote code execution through crafted documents, a classic vector frequently leveraged in targeted attacks.
items.reason_zh: Word 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出允许通过构造的文档实现远程代码执行，这是定向攻击中频繁使用的经典攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in the NTFS driver permits remote code execution over a network, compromising core file system integrity and stability.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 驱动程序中的不受信任的指针解引用漏洞允许通过网络执行远程代码，破坏核心文件系统的完整性和稳定性。

items.reason_en: Insecure library loading in Windows Installer allows local privilege escalation by exploiting improper input sanitization during software deployment.
items.reason_zh: Windows Installer 中的不安全库加载漏洞通过利用软件部署期间不当的输入净化机制，允许本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Xbox Live Networking Service enables remote code execution over a network. Its extreme severity score underscores immediate patching necessity for gaming and enterprise endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Xbox Live Networking Service 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许通过网络执行远程代码。其极高的严重程度评分强调了在游戏和企业终端上立即修补的必要性。

items.reason_en: A heap-based use-after-free flaw in Windows iSCSI permits unauthorized attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely. This directly threatens storage area network reliability and data integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 中的基于堆的用后释放漏洞允许未授权攻击者远程执行任意代码。这直接威胁到存储区域网络的可靠性和数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference in the NTFS file system driver allows local code execution with elevated privileges. Exploitation could bypass standard user isolation mechanisms on Windows hosts.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 文件系统驱动程序中的空指针解引用漏洞允许以提升的权限执行本地代码。利用该漏洞可能绕过 Windows 主机上的标准用户隔离机制。

items.reason_en: Critical heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Media Foundation allows remote code execution over a network, scoring 9.8 on the CVSS scale.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation 中的关键基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络执行远程代码，CVSS 评分高达 9.8。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Microsoft Color Management enables unauthorized remote code execution over a network, directly impacting user workstations.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Color Management 中的整数溢出漏洞可导致未经授权的远程代码执行，直接影响用户工作站。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Virtual Filtering Platform permits remote code execution over a network with a CVSS of 9.0, bypassing standard security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Windows Virtual Filtering Platform 中的释放后使用漏洞允许攻击者通过网络执行远程代码，CVSS 评分为 9.0，可绕过标准安全边界。

items.reason_en: Relative path traversal in Windows Print Spooler Components allows network-based privilege escalation, maintaining the historical exploitability risk of this subsystem.
items.reason_zh: Windows Print Spooler Components 中的相对路径遍历漏洞可实现基于网络的权限提升，延续了该子系统固有的可利用性风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows eSCL Scanner enables remote code execution over a network, posing a direct threat to printer and scanning infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows eSCL Scanner 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行，直接威胁打印机与扫描基础设施的安全。

items.reason_en: This critical heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Color Management allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network, severely compromising system stability and security.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Color Management 中的关键堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可使未授权攻击者通过网络执行代码，严重破坏系统稳定性与安全性。

items.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS) enables local privilege escalation, directly threatening credential protection mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS) 中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，直接威胁凭据保护机制。

items.reason_en: The heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Imaging Component permits remote code execution through malicious image files, posing a significant threat to endpoint integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows Imaging Component 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过恶意图像文件实现远程代码执行，对终端完整性构成重大威胁。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 remote code execution vulnerability in DirectMusic allows unauthorized attackers to execute arbitrary code over a network, posing a severe threat to end-user workstations.
items.reason_zh: DirectMusic 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的远程代码执行漏洞可使未授权攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，对终端用户工作站构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Exploitable sandbox escape via reparse points created by sandboxed processes enables local privilege escalation, directly undermining application isolation mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: 通过沙箱进程创建的重新解析点利用可实现沙箱逃逸，进而导致本地权限提升，直接破坏应用程序隔离机制。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in the Windows Codecs Library allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code over a network, impacting widespread media processing workflows.
items.reason_zh: Windows Codecs Library 中的整数下溢漏洞可使远程攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，影响广泛的媒体处理工作流。

items.reason_en: Improper restriction of rendered UI layers in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized users to bypass security features locally, risking developer environment compromise.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中对渲染 UI 层的不当限制可使未授权用户在本地绕过安全功能，危及开发环境安全。

items.reason_en: Allows malicious documents to load external Java database drivers, potentially executing arbitrary code upon opening crafted spreadsheets.
items.reason_zh: 允许恶意文档加载外部 Java 数据库驱动程序，在打开构造的电子表格时可能执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Bypasses macro security settings by binding commands to document events, enabling silent script execution when users open infected files.
items.reason_zh: 通过将命令绑定到文档事件来绕过宏安全设置，使用户在打开受感染文件时静默执行脚本。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in EDK2 BIOS firmware can compromise SMM handler integrity, leading to system instability or local privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: EDK2 BIOS 固件中的越界写入漏洞可能破坏 SMM 处理器完整性，导致系统不稳定或本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: UEFI firmware out-of-bounds write in Intel Slim Bootloader allows bare-metal OS privilege escalation via low-complexity startup code attacks.
items.reason_zh: Intel Slim Bootloader 中的 UEFI 固件越界写入漏洞可通过低复杂度的启动代码攻击实现裸机操作系统权限提升。

items.reason_en: Standard users can escalate privileges to SYSTEM by injecting code into a signed SandMan.exe process, bypassing integrity checks.
items.reason_zh: 普通用户可通过向已签名的 SandMan.exe 进程注入代码并绕过完整性检查，将权限提升至 SYSTEM。

items.reason_en: Malicious SKP file parsing triggers a use-after-free flaw that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code upon opening the document.
items.reason_zh: 恶意 SKP 文件解析会触发释放后使用漏洞，使远程攻击者在打开文档时执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: A file parsing vulnerability in the CAD software enables remote code execution through crafted Cobalt XE documents requiring user interaction.
items.reason_zh: 该 CAD 软件的文件解析漏洞可通过构造的 Cobalt XE 文档实现远程代码执行，但需要用户交互。

items.reason_en: Crafted data files trigger an out-of-bounds write in the Origin Viewer parser, allowing remote attackers to achieve code execution.
items.reason_zh: 构造的数据文件会在 Origin Viewer 解析器中触发越界写入，使远程攻击者能够实现代码执行。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in the .NET report designer allows local low-privilege attackers to execute arbitrary code.
items.reason_zh: .NET 报表设计器中对不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞可使本地低权限攻击者执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled search path in the Netskope Windows client enables local privilege escalation to SYSTEM, directly compromising endpoint security posture.
items.reason_zh: Netskope Windows 客户端中的不受控搜索路径漏洞可导致本地权限提升至 SYSTEM，直接破坏终端安全态势。

items.reason_en: Code injection vulnerability in Microsoft Teams for Android enables network-based spoofing attacks, threatening secure mobile communications and corporate data.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的代码注入漏洞可实现基于网络的欺骗攻击，威胁移动通信安全与企业数据。

items.reason_en: Origin validation failure in Microsoft Teams for Android facilitates network-based spoofing attacks against mobile users. This undermines communication integrity on widely deployed enterprise mobile platforms.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的源验证失败漏洞助长了针对移动用户的网络欺骗攻击，破坏了广泛部署的企业移动平台上的通信完整性。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in termux-sync's archive restoration process allows malicious manifests to write files outside intended directories, compromising device integrity.
items.reason_zh: termux-sync 的归档还原过程中的路径遍历漏洞可使恶意清单文件写入预期目录之外的文件，破坏设备完整性。

items.reason_en: Kernel-level out-of-bounds write in Intel Wireless Bluetooth drivers enables denial of service or potential adjacent access exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Intel 无线蓝牙驱动程序的内核级越界写入漏洞可导致拒绝服务或潜在的邻近访问漏洞利用。

items.reason_en: Origin validation error in FortiClient agents allows unauthorized remote attackers to execute code, compromising endpoint security across Windows and macOS.
items.reason_zh: FortiClient 代理中的源验证错误漏洞可使未授权远程攻击者执行代码，破坏 Windows 和 macOS 平台的终端安全。

items.reason_en: Incorrect permission assignment in the Samsung Update service allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code, undermining mobile device integrity.
items.reason_zh: Samsung Update 服务中的权限分配错误漏洞可使本地攻击者执行任意代码，破坏移动设备完整性。

items.reason_en: Classic buffer overflow in Samsung mTower firmware management software poses a risk of remote code execution on connected devices.
items.reason_zh: Samsung mTower 固件管理软件中的经典缓冲区溢出漏洞可能导致连接设备发生远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Re-introduced default OpenBMC root password after factory reset on Lenovo ThinkSystem XCC compromises hardware management interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Lenovo ThinkSystem XCC 出厂重置后重新引入默认 OpenBMC root 密码，导致硬件管理接口面临安全风险。

items.reason_en: OS command injection via crafted hostnames in Lenovo XClarity Integrator enables PowerShell execution on Windows Admin Center.
items.reason_zh: Lenovo XClarity Integrator 中通过构造的主机名实现的 OS 命令注入漏洞可在 Windows Admin Center 上执行 PowerShell 命令。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Philips Hue Bridge Pro allows network-adjacent attackers to gain unauthorized control over smart home ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: Philips Hue Bridge Pro 中的身份验证绕过漏洞允许网络相邻攻击者未经授权控制智能家居生态系统。

items.reason_en: Symlink following flaw in qbee.io IoT agent enables local unprivileged users to escalate privileges by manipulating SSH key configurations.
items.reason_zh: qbee.io IoT 代理中的符号链接跟踪缺陷使本地非特权用户能够通过操纵 SSH 密钥配置提升权限。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded credentials in Copeland XWEB EVO firmware allow unauthorized administrative access, severely compromising building automation and HVAC control systems.
items.reason_zh: Copeland XWEB EVO 固件中的硬编码凭据允许未经授权的访问，严重破坏楼宇自动化和 HVAC 控制系统。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded backdoor password in Copeland XWEB EVO firmware grants unauthenticated attackers full administrative access, enabling complete device takeover.
items.reason_zh: Copeland XWEB EVO 固件中的硬编码后门密码授予未认证攻击者完整的管理员访问权限，从而实现完全接管设备。

items.reason_en: CVSS 10 stack-based buffer overflow in D-Link DIR-600L authentication CGI allows remote exploitation, fully compromising home/office networking hardware.
items.reason_zh: D-Link DIR-600L 身份验证 CGI 中的 CVSS 10 栈缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程利用，完全破坏家庭/办公网络设备硬件的安全性。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in DJI AeroScope firmware updates allows attackers to flash malicious firmware and compromise device integrity.
items.reason_zh: DJI AeroScope 固件更新中不正确的加密签名验证机制允许攻击者刷入恶意固件并破坏设备完整性。

items.reason_en: ZIP extraction path traversal in Eclipse Kura IoT gateway allows authenticated users to overwrite system files and execute arbitrary commands.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse Kura IoT 网关中的 ZIP 解压路径遍历漏洞允许已认证用户覆盖系统文件并执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated .NET Remoting deserialization in RBH Integra32 security systems grants immediate remote code execution on exposed TCP ports.
items.reason_zh: RBH Integra32 安全系统中未认证的 .NET Remoting 反序列化漏洞可在暴露的 TCP 端口上立即实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Authenticated SQL injection in the smart home bridge's reporting module enables remote code execution on the connected hub.

items.reason_en: Unrestricted file upload functionality lacks proper access control, allowing attackers to deploy malicious payloads and achieve remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: 不受限制的文件上传功能缺乏适当的访问控制，允许攻击者部署恶意有效载荷并实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Incorrect permission assignment in Azure Front Door enables unauthorized privilege elevation over network resources.
items.reason_zh: Azure Front Door 中不正确的权限分配可启用未经授权的网络资源权限提升。

items.reason_en: Permission validation flaw in Octopus Deploy grants elevated system administrator access to regular users.
items.reason_zh: Octopus Deploy 中的权限验证缺陷使普通用户获得提升的系统管理员访问权限。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication cookie integrity combined with permission flaws in Octopus Deploy enables privilege escalation to Administrator.
items.reason_zh: Octopus Deploy 中身份验证 Cookie 完整性不足与权限缺陷相结合，可实现向管理员角色的权限提升。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Synology DSM Auth API allows authenticated attackers to read/write arbitrary files and disrupt services, impacting cloud storage deployments.
items.reason_zh: Synology DSM Auth API 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许已认证攻击者读取/写入任意文件并中断服务，影响云存储部署。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in HashiCorp Consul service mesh proxy registration permits unauthorized Envoy configuration changes, compromising cloud infrastructure security.
items.reason_zh: HashiCorp Consul 服务网格代理注册中的授权绕过漏洞允许未经授权修改 Envoy 配置，破坏云基础设施安全性。

items.reason_en: TLS identity overwrite in Docker SwarmKit Cluster-API proxy can lead to man-in-the-middle attacks during node redirection in container orchestration clusters.
items.reason_zh: Docker SwarmKit Cluster-API 代理中的 TLS 身份覆写漏洞可能导致在容器编排集群进行节点重定向时发生中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Azure Pipelines allows remote code execution within build agents, severely compromising software supply chains and automated deployment environments.
items.reason_zh: Azure Pipelines 中的命令注入漏洞允许在构建代理中实现远程代码执行，严重破坏软件供应链和自动化部署环境。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in ASP.NET Core enables privilege escalation over the network, weakening security boundaries for modern cloud-native web applications.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中不正确的身份验证机制可启用通过网络进行的权限提升，削弱现代云原生 Web 应用的安全边界。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Modern Device Management (MDM) allows remote code execution, jeopardizing enterprise device enrollment and centralized policy enforcement.
items.reason_zh: Windows Modern Device Management (MDM) 中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程代码执行，危及企业设备注册和集中式策略执行。

items.reason_en: Uninitialized resource usage in Windows Hyper-V can lead to local privilege escalation, potentially allowing guest virtual machine escape or host system compromise.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V 中未初始化资源的使用可导致本地权限提升，可能允许客户机虚拟机逃逸或主机系统被攻破。

items.reason_en: Improper privilege management in Azure Kubernetes Service allows authorized users to escalate privileges locally, threatening containerized workloads and cloud-native architectures.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service 中不正确的权限管理机制允许已授权用户在本地提升权限，威胁容器化工作负载和云原生架构。

items.reason_en: Perfect score indicates critical authorization bypass in Entra Device Registration, enabling full account takeover.
items.reason_zh: 满分表明 Entra Device Registration 中存在严重的授权绕过漏洞，可实现完整的账户接管。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure OpenAI allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network.
items.reason_zh: Azure OpenAI 中缺失的身份验证机制允许未经授权通过网络进行权限提升。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Microsoft Graph exposes enterprise APIs to unauthorized elevation of privileges.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Graph 中不正确的授权机制使企业 API 面临未经授权权限提升的风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Azure Confidential Clean Rooms risks data tampering by authorized users.
items.reason_zh: Azure Confidential Clean Rooms 中缺失的授权机制存在经授权用户篡改数据的风险。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure Managed Grafana allows unauthorized privilege escalation, potentially exposing internal cloud metrics and infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Azure Managed Grafana 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞允许未经授权权限提升，可能暴露内部云指标和基础设施。

items.reason_en: Path traversal flaw in Azure CycleCloud enables local privilege escalation, risking container orchestration security and multi-tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中的路径遍历漏洞可启用本地权限提升，危及容器编排安全性和多租户隔离性。

items.reason_en: Time-of-check time-of-use race condition in Windows Hyper-V allows local privilege escalation within virtualized environments. Attackers leveraging this flaw could escape VM isolation to compromise host resources.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V 中的检查时与使用时（TOCTOU）竞态条件可导致虚拟化环境内的本地权限提升。攻击者利用此缺陷可突破虚拟机隔离以获取主机资源的控制权。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in the Container Isolation FS Filter Driver weakens container security boundaries. Successful exploitation may enable lateral movement between isolated container workloads.
items.reason_zh: Container Isolation FS Filter Driver 中的非受信指针解引用削弱了容器安全边界。成功利用该漏洞可实现隔离容器工作负载之间的横向移动。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Azure CycleCloud allows unauthorized information disclosure over a network, potentially exposing sensitive cloud workload configurations.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中的路径遍历漏洞允许通过网络进行未授权的信息泄露，可能暴露敏感的云工作负载配置。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Azure DevOps Server allows network-based privilege escalation, jeopardizing secure software delivery pipelines and cloud-hosted repositories.
items.reason_zh: Azure DevOps Server 中的授权绕过漏洞允许基于网络的权限提升，危及安全的软件交付流水线及云托管代码库。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Azure DevOps allows remote attackers to execute code over a network, threatening CI/CD pipelines and source code repositories.
items.reason_zh: Azure DevOps 中的身份验证不当漏洞允许远程攻击者通过网络执行代码，威胁 CI/CD 流水线及源代码仓库。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Azure CycleCloud enables privileged command execution over a network, risking container orchestration and compute cluster control.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许通过网络执行特权命令，危及容器编排与计算集群的控制权。

items.reason_en: Automatic GPT partition mounting in OpenShift confidential computing guest images bypasses user confirmation, potentially exposing sensitive tenant data at boot.
items.reason_zh: OpenShift 机密计算客户机镜像中的自动 GPT 分区挂载绕过了用户确认，可能在系统启动时暴露敏感的租户数据。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Dokploy allows authenticated members to execute shell commands, fully compromising containerized application deployments.
items.reason_zh: Dokploy 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许已认证成员执行 Shell 命令，从而导致容器化应用部署被完全控制。

items.reason_en: Incorrect operation name normalization in AWS API MCP Server bypasses security policies, enabling unauthorized cross-service API calls.
items.reason_zh: AWS API MCP Server 中的操作名称规范化错误绕过了安全策略，导致未授权的跨服务 API 调用。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Eclipse Otterdog credential providers lets organization admins execute arbitrary commands with operator privileges, risking secret theft.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse Otterdog 凭据提供程序中的命令注入漏洞允许组织管理员以操作员权限执行任意命令，存在密钥窃取风险。

items.reason_en: Improper certificate validation in Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules exposes infrastructure management APIs to man-in-the-middle attacks and unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules 中的证书验证不当漏洞使基础设施管理 API 面临中间人攻击与未授权访问的风险。

items.reason_en: An untrusted search path in the AWS Deadline Cloud worker agent allows authenticated job submitters to execute arbitrary code on Linux hosts.
items.reason_zh: AWS Deadline Cloud Worker Agent 中的非受信搜索路径漏洞允许已认证的任务提交者在 Linux 主机上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Argument injection in the Kubernetes monitoring agent permits rule editors to write arbitrary files and execute code via crafted node roles.
items.reason_zh: Kubernetes 监控代理中的参数注入漏洞允许规则编辑器通过构造的节点角色写入任意文件并执行代码。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on certificate management endpoints allows unauthenticated attackers to modify trusted EPM Core entries, compromising identity trust chains.
items.reason_zh: 证书管理端点缺失身份验证机制，允许未认证的攻击者修改受信任的 EPM Core 条目，从而破坏身份信任链。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Dell PowerStore storage appliances allows limited-privilege users to escalate to root and fully compromise the system.
items.reason_zh: Dell PowerStore 存储设备中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许低权限用户提权至 root 并完全控制系统。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Control Web Panel exploits predictable legacy signatures to gain unauthorized remote API access, threatening server management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Control Web Panel 中的授权绕过漏洞利用可预测的旧版签名获取未授权的远程 API 访问权限，威胁服务器管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Citrix NetScaler Console allows unauthorized administrative access to critical delivery infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Citrix NetScaler Console 中的身份验证绕过漏洞允许未授权的管理员访问关键交付基础设施。

items.reason_en: Memory overflow in Citrix NetScaler Push service leads to severe denial of service in enterprise networking environments.
items.reason_zh: Citrix NetScaler Push 服务中的内存溢出漏洞会导致企业网络环境中出现严重的拒绝服务（DoS）。

items.reason_en: OS command injection via HA join-request packets in Fortinet FortiMail enables full remote code execution on mail appliances.
items.reason_zh: 通过 Fortinet FortiMail 的 HA 加入请求数据包实现的操作系统命令注入漏洞，可在邮件设备上实现完整的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Fortinet FortiMail processing allows unauthorized code execution and sensitive data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiMail 数据处理过程中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许未授权代码执行及敏感数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Fortinet FortiMail enables unauthenticated access to secure email accounts via crafted HTTP requests.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiMail 中的身份验证不当漏洞允许攻击者通过构造的 HTTP 请求未认证访问加密邮箱账户。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Fortinet FortiMail allows unauthenticated takeover of IBE webmail sessions for reading and sending mail.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiMail 中的授权逻辑错误允许未认证攻击者接管 IBE Webmail 会话，从而读取和发送邮件。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS allows attackers to access restricted files across multiple firewall and PAM versions.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiOS 中的路径遍历漏洞允许攻击者在多款防火墙及 PAM 版本中访问受限文件。

items.reason_en: Hard-coded password flaw in Fortinet FortiAuthenticator enables unauthenticated credential validation bypass, risking unauthorized network access.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiAuthenticator 中的硬编码密码缺陷允许未认证绕过凭据验证，存在未授权网络访问风险。

items.reason_en: Session management weakness in HPE systems allows attackers to retain unauthorized access after account state changes, compromising enterprise infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: HPE 系统中的会话管理缺陷允许攻击者在账户状态变更后维持未授权访问，从而破坏企业基础设施。

items.reason_en: Static cryptographic keys in Arista Wi-Fi access points allow attackers to forge firmware updates, completely undermining device integrity and wireless network security.
items.reason_zh: Arista Wi-Fi 接入点中的静态加密密钥允许攻击者伪造固件更新，彻底破坏设备完整性与无线网络安全性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows SMB protocol enables remote code execution over the network, sustaining its reputation as a primary lateral movement target.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB 协议中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络实现远程代码执行，维持了其作为主要横向移动目标的高危地位。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Windows LDAP allows remote code execution, threatening directory services that serve as the backbone for centralized infrastructure authentication.
items.reason_zh: Windows LDAP 中的越界写入漏洞允许远程代码执行，威胁作为集中式基础设施身份验证核心的目录服务。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in Windows Kerberos facilitates privilege escalation over the network, undermining core identity management and single sign-on protocols.
items.reason_zh: Windows Kerberos 中的身份验证薄弱漏洞可导致网络权限提升，削弱核心身份管理与单点登录（SSO）协议的安全性。

items.reason_en: Sensitive authentication credentials may be exposed in diagnostic data during Arista EOS Smart Switch Upgrades, undermining network security controls and device hardening.
items.reason_zh: 在 Arista EOS Smart Switch 升级过程中，诊断数据可能泄露敏感的身份验证凭据，从而破坏网络安全管控措施与设备加固策略。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Remote Desktop Gateway Service enables network-based privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Gateway Service 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致基于网络的权限提升。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Windows Kerberos allows network elevation of privileges without valid credentials, severely undermining enterprise identity infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows Kerberos 中的身份验证绕过漏洞允许在无需有效凭据的情况下通过网络提升权限，严重破坏企业身份基础设施。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in DNS Server enables remote code execution, disrupting critical name resolution services across the network.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，破坏网络范围内的关键名称解析服务。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows NetBIOS allows network-based privilege escalation, exposing legacy network protocols to active exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Windows NetBIOS 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致基于网络的权限提升，使传统网络协议面临实际利用风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Windows NAT implementation enables remote code execution across adjacent networks. This compromises routing infrastructure and exposes internal network segments to takeover.
items.reason_zh: Windows NAT 实现中的释放后使用漏洞可导致跨相邻网络的远程代码执行。该漏洞会破坏路由基础设施，并使内部网段面临被接管的风险。

items.reason_en: Improper link resolution before file access in Windows DNS allows network-based privilege escalation. Misconfigured or malicious DNS responses could trigger unintended administrative actions.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中文件访问前的链接解析不当可导致基于网络的权限提升。配置错误或恶意的 DNS 响应可能触发非预期的管理操作。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows DNS Server allows remote code execution over a network, compromising essential name resolution services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS Server 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过网络实现远程代码执行，危及关键名称解析服务。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in DNS Server enables network-based code execution, disrupting foundational network infrastructure operations.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的越界写入漏洞可导致基于网络的代码执行，破坏基础网络基础设施的运行。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in DNS Server permits remote code execution over a network, rated 8.1 CVSS, requiring immediate patching for network stability.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，CVSS 评分为 8.1，需立即修补以保障网络稳定性。

items.reason_en: An out-of-bounds read in the Windows DHCP Server enables unauthorized remote code execution, critically destabilizing network address assignment infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的越界读取漏洞可导致未授权的远程代码执行，严重破坏网络地址分配基础设施。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the DNS Server allows remote code execution, threatening the reliability and security of critical name resolution services.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，威胁关键名称解析服务的可靠性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference in the Windows TCP/IP stack enables remote denial of service, disrupting fundamental network connectivity for affected systems.
items.reason_zh: Windows TCP/IP 协议栈中的空指针解引用漏洞可导致远程拒绝服务，中断受影响系统的基础网络连接。

items.reason_en: Double free in Windows DNS service allows remote attackers to execute code over a network, destabilizing critical name resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 服务中的双重释放漏洞允许远程攻击者通过网络执行代码，破坏关键名称解析基础设施的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Windows DNS enables remote code execution, directly targeting foundational network services used across enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中对不受信任数据的反序列化可导致远程代码执行，直接针对企业环境中广泛使用的基础网络服务。

items.reason_en: ToCTOU race condition in Windows DHCP Server allows remote code execution over a network, disrupting IP address management and network connectivity.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的竞态条件（ToCTOU）漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，破坏 IP 地址管理与网络连接。

items.reason_en: Hard-coded FTP daemon credentials in D-Link routers allow unauthenticated remote attackers to gain full administrative control of the network appliance.
items.reason_zh: D-Link 路由器中硬编码的 FTP 守护进程凭据允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者获取网络设备的全权管理控制权。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication for critical HA configuration sync functions in FortiOS enables unauthenticated attackers to push malicious global configurations remotely.
items.reason_zh: FortiOS 中关键的高可用性（HA）配置同步功能缺少身份验证，使得未经身份验证的攻击者能够远程推送恶意全局配置。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on NETGEAR RAX models allows Wi-Fi connected attackers to tamper with device settings and extract administrator credentials without login.
items.reason_zh: NETGEAR RAX 系列型号缺少身份验证机制，允许通过 Wi-Fi 连接的攻击者在未登录的情况下篡改设备设置并提取管理员凭据。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild, this authentication bypass in Barracuda Email Security Gateway allows attackers to restore crafted backups and modify global appliance settings.
items.reason_zh: 该 Barracuda Email Security Gateway 的身份验证绕过漏洞已在实际环境中被活跃利用，允许攻击者恢复伪造的备份文件并修改设备的全局设置。

items.reason_en: Remote command injection in the router's CGI interface allows attackers to take full control of the network device without authentication.
items.reason_zh: 路由器 CGI 接口中的远程命令注入漏洞允许攻击者在无需身份验证的情况下完全控制网络设备。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in FortiMail enables unauthenticated attackers to execute unauthorized code or commands on the appliance.
items.reason_zh: FortiMail 中的路径遍历漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者在设备上执行未授权代码或命令。

items.reason_en: Improper encoding or escaping in FortiAnalyzer outputs can lead to critical system compromise and unauthorized command execution.
items.reason_zh: FortiAnalyzer 输出内容的编码或转义处理不当可能导致严重的系统沦陷及未授权命令执行。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Dell SmartFabric OS10 allows low-privileged remote attackers to execute commands on network switching infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Dell SmartFabric OS10 中的授权校验错误允许低权限远程攻击者在网络交换基础设施上执行命令。

items.reason_en: Improper certificate validation in Fortinet FortiAnalyzer and FortiManager enables man-in-the-middle attacks and unauthorized access to critical network monitoring systems.
items.reason_zh: Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 和 FortiManager 中的证书验证不当可导致中间人攻击，并使攻击者能够未经授权访问关键网络监控系统。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Johnson Controls iSTAR building automation controllers allows remote code execution on critical infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Johnson Controls iSTAR 楼宇自动化控制器中的操作系统命令注入漏洞可对关键基础设施实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Configuration handling flaw in rt-labs P-Net industrial Ethernet stack could disrupt device state management and operational continuity.
items.reason_zh: rt-labs P-Net 工业以太网协议栈中的配置处理缺陷可能破坏设备状态管理与运行连续性。

items.reason_en: Stack-based out-of-bounds write in the BACnet protocol stack affects building automation and control systems. Remediation is critical to prevent unauthorized manipulation of industrial monitoring equipment.
items.reason_zh: BACnet 协议栈中的基于栈的越界写入漏洞影响楼宇自动化与控制系统。修复该漏洞对于防止工业监控设备被未授权操纵至关重要。

items.reason_en: Authenticated OS command injection in Copeland XWEB EVO template handling allows attackers to execute arbitrary shell commands, risking HVAC and building automation systems.
items.reason_zh: Copeland XWEB EVO 模板处理中的需认证操作系统命令注入漏洞允许攻击者执行任意 Shell 命令，危及暖通空调（HVAC）及楼宇自动化系统。

items.reason_en: Critical remote code execution via untrusted data deserialization in PTC Windchill and FlexPLM compromises engineering and manufacturing data environments.
items.reason_zh: PTC Windchill 和 FlexPLM 中因不受信任数据反序列化导致的严重远程代码执行漏洞，会危及工程与制造数据环境。

items.reason_en: Exposed IOCTL functions in Beckhoff TcRouter.sys allow low-privileged attackers to move arbitrary physical memory, fully compromising PLC devices.
items.reason_zh: Beckhoff TcRouter.sys 中暴露的 IOCTL 函数允许低权限攻击者操作任意物理内存，从而完全攻陷可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）设备。

items.reason_en: Parsing flaws in BACnet Stack WebSocket URI handling cause buffer overflows, disrupting building automation networks and enabling potential remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: BACnet Stack WebSocket URI处理中的解析缺陷会导致缓冲区溢出，破坏楼宇自动化网络并可能导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Failure to properly sanitize path references in manipulated files allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on industrial control workstations.

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables remote code execution, threatening enterprise document management and collaboration platforms.

items.reason_zh: LearnDash WordPress插件中的批量赋值漏洞可导致权限提升，使非管理员能够修改用户角色并访问受限内容。

items.reason_zh: Control Web Panel 中的主机头注入漏洞允许未认证攻击者篡改密码恢复 URL，从而协助实施账户接管攻击。

items.reason_zh: NextScan 中使用硬编码 JWT 签名密钥的认证绕过漏洞允许未认证攻击者伪造管理员令牌并获取完整的系统访问权限。

items.reason_zh: Prime CMS 中被注释掉的认证守卫导致未认证用户可注册账号并通过 GraphQL 变更执行账户接管。

items.reason_zh: Apache Roller 旧版 API 中缺失的授权检查允许已认证用户在无限制的情况下读取、修改或删除其他用户的日志内容。

items.reason_en: Reinstallation bypass in sysPass allows attackers to overwrite configuration files and hijack password manager instances without prior authentication checks.
items.reason_zh: sysPass 中的重新安装绕过漏洞允许攻击者在未经前置认证检查的情况下覆盖配置文件并劫持密码管理器实例。

items.reason_en: CSRF flaw in Apache Roller permits unauthenticated attackers to create administrator accounts if a logged-in admin clicks a malicious link.
items.reason_zh: Apache Roller 中的 CSRF 缺陷允许未认证攻击者在已登录的管理员点击恶意链接时创建管理员账户。

items.reason_en: Webhook authorization bypass in the WordPress plugin allows unauthenticated attackers to reset passwords and compromise site administration.
items.reason_zh: WordPress 插件中的 Webhook 授权绕过漏洞允许未认证攻击者重置密码并破坏站点管理功能。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded JWT secret key enables attackers to forge administrator tokens, resulting in complete unauthenticated account takeover.
items.reason_zh: 硬编码的 JWT 密钥使攻击者能够伪造管理员令牌，从而导致完全的未认证账户接管。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization checks on cloud storage integration endpoints allow unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files to the server.
items.reason_zh: 云存储集成端点缺失的授权检查允许未认证攻击者向服务器写入任意文件。

items.reason_zh: Barn2 Document Library Pro 中的反序列化漏洞允许对象注入，并在广泛的 WordPress 部署中可能导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits remote code execution, risking complete compromise of enterprise database environments and sensitive data.

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in SQL Server enables remote privilege escalation, exposing critical database management capabilities to exploitation.

items.reason_en: Case sensitivity mishandling in IBM API Connect access controls allows remote attackers to bypass restrictions and execute unauthorized administrative operations.

items.reason_en: Exposure of sensitive server-side environment variables and Java runtime details in IBM webMethods Integration Server aids reconnaissance and further exploitation.
items.reason_zh: IBM webMethods Integration Server 中敏感服务端环境变量和 Java 运行时细节的泄露有助于攻击者进行侦察和进一步利用。

items.reason_zh: OpenCTI 中的组织管理员可替换可授予权限的组，导致权限提升超出预期的威胁情报范围。

items.reason_en: DoS via unbounded checksum computation in rsync allows malicious receivers to overwhelm delta-transfer senders.
items.reason_zh: rsync 中无限制的校验和计算可导致拒绝服务，使恶意接收方能够压垮增量传输发送方。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in libilbm allows remote code execution via malicious ILBM file parsing, affecting applications handling legacy bitmap formats.
items.reason_zh: libilbm 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许通过恶意解析 ILBM 文件执行远程代码，影响处理传统位图格式的应用程序。

items.reason_en: Static signature payloads in IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway allow identity claim replay and data exposure.
items.reason_zh: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 中的静态签名载荷允许身份声明重放和数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Visual Studio enables remote code execution over a network. Compromised developer toolchains pose severe supply chain and CI/CD pipeline risks.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio 中反序列化不受信任的数据允许通过网络执行远程代码。被攻陷的开发工具链会对供应链和 CI/CD 流水线构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization controls in Visual Studio Code allow unauthorized network information disclosure. Exposed IDE telemetry or configuration files could leak sensitive development artifacts.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中缺少授权控制会导致未授权的网络信息泄露。暴露的 IDE 遥测数据或配置文件可能泄露敏感的开发工件。

items.reason_en: Untrusted search path vulnerability in Visual Studio Code allows remote code execution, affecting developer workstations and automated build environments.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的不受信任搜索路径漏洞允许远程代码执行，影响开发人员工作站和自动化构建环境。

items.reason_en: Information disclosure in Intel TDX MigTD SPDM responder may expose sensitive hypervisor memory, impacting confidential computing workloads.
items.reason_zh: Intel TDX MigTD SPDM 响应器中的信息泄露可能暴露敏感的虚拟机监控器内存，影响机密计算工作负载。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in SakanaAI text-to-LoRA model loading function allows attackers to read or overwrite arbitrary files, compromising AI training pipelines.
items.reason_zh: SakanaAI text-to-LoRA 模型加载函数中存在路径遍历漏洞，攻击者可读取或覆盖任意文件，从而破坏 AI 训练流水线。

items.reason_en: PATH traversal in NLTK's Graphviz resolution allows execution of arbitrary binaries, posing risks to NLP research and automated documentation tools.
items.reason_zh: NLTK 的 Graphviz 解析过程中存在 PATH 遍历漏洞，可导致任意二进制文件的执行，对自然语言处理研究和自动化文档工具构成风险。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in C-Kermit server command parsing allows malicious peers to corrupt memory and potentially execute arbitrary code via crafted packets.
items.reason_zh: C-Kermit 服务器命令解析中存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，恶意对等节点可通过构造的数据包破坏内存并可能执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: AIOHTTP multipart chunk processing lacks byte limits, causing severe memory exhaustion and denial of service when processing malformed base64 payloads.
items.reason_zh: AIOHTTP 的多部分分块处理缺乏字节数限制，在处理畸形 Base64 载荷时会导致严重的内存耗尽和拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in Git three-way merge code can be triggered by controlled repositories, risking crash or arbitrary code execution during routine merges.
items.reason_zh: Git 三路合并代码中存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，受控仓库可触发该漏洞，在常规合并期间可能导致崩溃或任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Certificate serial manipulation bypasses authentication in the Magma cloud orchestration REST API, exposing telecom infrastructure management.
items.reason_zh: 证书序列号操纵可绕过 Magma 云编排 REST API 的身份验证，导致电信基础设施管理暴露。

items.reason_en: AI agent logging in IBM App Connect may inadvertently expose sensitive environment secrets within generated error messages.
items.reason_zh: IBM App Connect 中 AI 代理的日志记录功能可能会在生成的错误消息中意外泄露敏感的环境密钥。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the dr_libs WAV metadata parser allows arbitrary memory corruption when processing specially crafted audio files.
items.reason_zh: dr_libs 的 WAV 元数据解析器中存在越界写入漏洞，在处理特制音频文件时可能导致任意内存损坏。
